# Response length penalty: penalize responses exceeding threshold
_lp_coef = getattr(self.config, 'response_length_penalty_coef', 0.0)
_lp_threshold = getattr(self.config, 'response_length_penalty_threshold', 4096)
if _lp_coef > 0:
    _resp_mask = batch.batch["response_mask"]
    _resp_lengths = _resp_mask.sum(dim=-1).float()  # (batch_size,)
    _excess = (_resp_lengths - _lp_threshold).clamp(min=0)
    _penalty = -_lp_coef * _excess / _lp_threshold  # normalized penalty
    # Add penalty to last valid token position of each sample
    _last_pos = _resp_mask.sum(dim=-1).long() - 1
    _last_pos = _last_pos.clamp(min=0)
    for _i in range(_penalty.shape[0]):
